name: Halle Winkler
bio: Halle Winkler is a veteran indie software engineer and end-user privacy advocate, who became an offensive security researcher and a consulting application security engineer for Apple platforms. She is a Certified Ethical Hacker, with 12 Apple Security credits spanning all Apple devices, and publishes the [Berlin Bassline Brief](https://buttondown.com/Halle/archive/) security newsletter. Previously, she brought offline speech recognition to iOS with OpenEars. She lives in Kreuzberg, Berlin and secretly adores it, but don't let it get around.
